target_customer: Small business owners seeking loans, with lenders as the likely payers
problem: Owners spend about 25 hours searching and applying for loans, often with lenders that reject them. OwnersCircle compared lenders and loan products in one place.
business_model: Lead generation or referral fees from lenders (not stated by a source)

founders.name: Matthew Christen
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page with no bio.

founders.name: Broderick McClinton
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page with no bio.

founders.name: Eric Sonnier
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page with no bio.

exit.reason: No shutdown notice found. YC lists the company as inactive.

competitors.name: Fundera
competitors.what: Online marketplace matching small businesses with alternative lenders, taking a 1 to 3 percent lender fee
competitors.traction_then: Private beta matched over 200 companies with lenders, nine resulting in loans
competitors.funding_then: 3.4 million dollars from investors including Khosla and First Round Capital

technical_complexity.rationale: A comparison and referral site with lender data. Lender integrations and data freshness were the work, not research.

defensibility.rationale: Lender relationships were available to every comparison site and Fundera had launched with funding months earlier.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Fundera grew into a major small business loan marketplace; no source shows OwnersCircle being copied or bought.

market_need_then: The YC description cites 25 hours spent on average searching and applying for loans and growth in alternative lenders. Fundera raising 3.4 million dollars in February 2014 for the same wedge shows investor interest.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain explainer language focused on owners' time

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand material found. The one liner 'Kickstarter for local businesses' does not match the loan comparison description, which blurs the message.

outcome_analysis: OwnersCircle was a two person Summer 2014 company offering lender comparison for small businesses. The YC one liner describes crowdfunding for local businesses while the long description describes loan search, which hints at a change of direction, but no dated source confirms it. No funding, press about the outcome or shutdown cause was found, so the cause is not public and failure factors stay empty. Fundera, funded earlier, was the clearest rival.
notes: Company website is blank on YC and no site was found, so treated as dead or unlisted. Wellfound names different founders (Obinna Okogbue, Usman Cheema) which conflicts with the YC page; YC names are used. Crunchbase gave no figures. No funding found in any outlet, so unknown is not zero. Competitor source is Fundera coverage from February 2014, a few months before the Summer 2014 batch.
